activity.action: Payment server bug found and fixed on a branch (not deployed)
activity.detail: A parallel replay of one payment could add two pass periods (a 30-day payment gave 60 days) for every product, including Screen Time Tracker. Fix: Mangesh347/Extension PR 2, 153/153 tests. Merging deploys to production, so it waits for a founder YES. Shield catalog entry: PR 3 (stacked on PR 2).

decisions.text: Shield Ad Blocker: no new backend (Nhost not adopted; the shared payment server already owns licences); Pro sold as licence keys at $2.99 per 30 days and $19.99 per 365 days (hypothesis); Peter Lowe's list and URLhaus left out on licence grounds; Google sign-in and trial wait for the store item id.
